fusions.name: Stripping Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses a ring of biting spiderlings, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Strip and Sip
fusions.desc: Spits a bolt that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Brood Let Loose
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a brood of spiderlings for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Gorged on Plenty
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 15 seconds.
